overlap_note: Zero-shot amazon/chronos-2; its pretraining corpus is not enumerated against PMData, so cohort overlap is unknown. Personal history enters only as the causal 48 h context; PMData clock mapping and historical availability are documented assumptions. Apple-density variant: the 48 h context is hourly means of PMData heart rate thinned to one sample per UTC 5-minute slot (configs/evaluation/pmdata-hourly-validation-apple-density.json); targets stay full density.
